interpretation: historical route-level predictive connectivity is estimable and varies substantially among the 17 staging-segment pairs
the preregistered prediction that higher connectivity strengthens wigeon phase correction is not supported
the point estimate is slightly positive rather than negative and is highly uncertain
this negative result remains part of the integrated evidence hierarchy and does not retune the Bayesian game
claim_boundary: the basic wigeon phase-retention result was known before this new predictor analysis
connectivity was estimated only from 2000-2017 ERA5 TGS onset before the 2018-2020 outcome period
the result does not test climate-driven temporal degradation of predictive connectivity
the result does not test community-level coordination hysteresis
